Title: Theft Of Vitae vs Zip Gun

Messages.Author: Murray Rutherford
Messages.Body:
When in combat with another vampire witch only has one
blood left and is using a Zip Gun as his strike and the
attacking vampire is using Thefh Of Vitea as his strike.
What happens to the blood of the opposing vampire?

Does the bloob get successfully stolen or is it just lost
when the Zip Gun gets fired for the first time in that combat
causing one damage to both shooter and the vampire being shoot?

ANY IDEAS??

THANX SAMUEL

PS THIS IS NOT MY ACCC

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <25APR95.13...@tscc.macarthur.uws.edu.au>,


Blood stolen is moved as the damage is applied (as the strike resolves).
Blood is paid to heal damage *after*the strikes have resolved.

So:
Zipper fires. Theft Occurs.
Zipper moves one blood from himself to Thief. Thief takes 1 damage and Zipper
takes 1 damage.
Thief and Zipper spend blood to heal damage. Zipper, with no blood left to
heal with, goes to torpor.

Messages.Author: Marko Puumalainen
Messages.Body:
lsc...@crl.com (L. Scott Johnson) writes:

>In article <25APR95.13...@tscc.macarthur.uws.edu.au>,
>Murray Rutherford <RA...@music.macarthur.uws.EDU.AU> wrote:
>>
>> When in combat with another vampire witch only has one
>>blood left and is using a Zip Gun as his strike and the
>>attacking vampire is using Thefh Of Vitea as his strike.

>Zipper fires. Theft Occurs.

Except that Theft cannot occur because the vampire with Zip Gun
doesn't have any blood left after paying for Zip Gun. If the Zip Gun
was already paid and there was still one blood left then the theft
could be performed (just one blood, though). Either way, the vampire
with Zip Gun will go to torpor from the damage from the Zip Gun.
